connections_title: Need connected email for this task?
connections_setup: Accounts are optional. Open Connections to see this build’s Google sign-in options and review the requested access. Then choose which chats or follow-ups can use the account.
empty_sources: Local files only. Configure a connection to include email.
pilot_start: Start with /followup new: watch selected project files and optional Gmail, identify the next useful step, and prepare a response for review.
help: Connected accounts: Google supports Drive metadata, Docs, Sheets and Gmail with the required account permissions. Gmail sending is enabled separately in Connections and each send needs exact approval. Google Calendar and Tasks are unavailable; dates and reminders can be tracked in Gator’s local plans. Open Connections to see this build’s sign-in options. Selecting an account does not verify access or approve changes.
model_connections: Connections: Chat settings selects sources for future requests. Settings → Connections handles account setup, browser sign-in, live account/read checks, reconnect and disconnect. Builds with a configured distribution client offer Google sign-in; other builds require a user-owned Desktop OAuth client. Inspect the actual connection options instead of claiming either setup is always present. Never ask for credentials in chat. Built-in Google operations cover Drive metadata, Docs, Sheets and Gmail; Google Calendar and Tasks operations are unavailable. Track user-provided dates and reminders in local plans instead. Gmail supports thread reads and reviewed sends with explicit To/Cc/Bcc recipients and selected-file attachments. Enable email sending in Connections requires another reviewed browser consent; each send still needs fresh exact approval. Original uploads that have only an extracted-text view cannot be sent as their original binary files. Only this run’s selected connections and available tools can be used. Selection does not prove authentication, a successful read or permission to change anything. Do not claim access to all email, calendars, files, browser tabs or the screen. Do not claim a send or other change succeeded without its tool result.
model_availability: Execution availability: desktop tasks belong to this computer; closing the desktop stops its active tasks. The optional experimental phone companion uses a separately configured online host with its own accessible files/accounts and device authorization. Desktop tasks do not automatically migrate to that host, and an offline laptop’s files are not remotely available. Do not claim that a companion is deployed, paired or online without observed evidence. Background checks need their selected host and supervisor running.
